name: Data Science Manager
description_html:
About The Opportunity

Our confidential client is a technology-driven organisation operating in a high-urgency, customer-facing environment where reliability, scale, security, and data-informed decision-making are critical.

We are seeking a hands-on Data Science Manager to lead the development of analytical and machine-learning capabilities that support business growth, operational performance, customer experience, and strategic decision-making.

This role requires a leader who can translate complex business problems into practical, measurable data solutions; develop a capable team; and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Technology, and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing data science and analytics team.
  • Define and execute a practical data science roadmap aligned with business priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Technology, and commercial stakeholders to identify high-impact data opportunities.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytics, experimentation, forecasting, optimisation, segmentation, predictive-modelling, or machine-learning initiatives.
  • Oversee the end-to-end data science lifecycle: problem framing, data exploration, feature development, model design, validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish standards for data quality, experimentation, statistical rigour, model validation, documentation, reproducibility, and responsible use of data.
  • Ensure models and analytical products are reliable, scalable, explainable where appropriate, and fit for production environments.
  • Work with Data Engineering and Software Engineering teams to improve data accessibility, data pipelines, model deployment, and model monitoring.
  • Communicate insights, recommendations, risks, and model performance clearly to senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Drive adoption of data-informed decision-making across relevant business and operational functions.
  • Define success metrics for data science initiatives, including business impact, model performance, operational adoption, and return on investment.
  • Contribute to data governance, privacy, security, and model-risk practices.
  • Support team planning, recruitment, capability development, and the continuing maturity of the data science function.


Qualifications And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Physics, or another relevant quantitative discipline.
  • Proven experience leading data science, advanced analytics, machine learning, or decision-science initiatives.
  • Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including coaching, developing, and managing data science or analytics professionals.
  • Strong practical understanding of statistical analysis, experimental design, predictive modelling, machine learning, and data storytelling.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Experience working with large, complex, and production-relevant data sets.
  • Experience translating business needs into analytical and machine-learning solutions with measurable impact.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced technology or operational environment.
  • Strong commercial judgement to prioritise data initiatives based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and expected impact.
  • Clear communication skills, including explaining technical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Professional English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud data and machine-learning platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent environments.
  • Experience with MLOps practices, including model versioning, experiment tracking, CI/CD, monitoring, and model governance.
  • Experience in a large-scale digital, platform, fintech, e-commerce, marketplace, logistics, mobility, or other technology-driven environment.
  • Experience with customer analytics, risk, fraud, personalisation, recommendation, optimisation, operational intelligence, or other data-intensive use cases.


Application Note

Noraa & Co. is supporting this recruitment process on behalf of our confidential client. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion.

name: Data Analyst / Data Engineer – SCG Indonesia
description_html:
About SCG in Indonesia

With operations spanning manufacturing, packaging, and distribution, SCG generates a wealth of data in Indonesia. Turning this data into insights is essential for driving efficiency, customer value, and sustainability.


For analytics professionals, this role offers a platform to work on high-impact data projects across industries.


About the Role

As a Data Analyst / Data Engineer, you will collect, process, and analyze data to support decision-making across SCG Indonesia’s businesses.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build data pipelines and ensure data quality.
  • Develop dashboards and reports for business teams.
  • Analyze trends in operations, sales, and supply chain.
  • Support forecasting, cost analysis, and performance tracking.
  • Document data flows and support governance practices.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s in Data Science, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • 0–3 years in analytics or engineering; new graduates are welcome.
  • Skills in SQL, Python, Excel, or BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Strong analytical and communication skills.


Career Development

Pathways into data engineering, business intelligence, or regional digital strategy roles across SCG’s network.

name: Senior Data Analyst (Remote)
description_html:
Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.

Cinch is Southeast Asia's leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle.

We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends—sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access—creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption.

At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we're creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers—and where the work has real, lasting impact.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead data-driven decision-making at Cinch. You will analyse complex datasets, identify trends, and turn them into strategic insights that improve business performance.

You will design and implement data models, build dashboards, and partner with cross-functional teams and leadership. The role involves advanced statistical analysis, predictive modelling, and data visualisation using SQL (Python is a strong plus), alongside extensive hands-on experience with BI tools. You should be an expert in dimensional modelling, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas.

This is a team lead and individual contributor role. You will manage a team of data analysts, mentor and coach them, and review their work for correctness and integrity before it reaches the business.

You are also expected to be AI-literate and comfortable working with both Claude Desktop and Claude Code. We expect responsible AI usage, and the correctness of all work submitted remains the analyst's own responsibility.

Responsibilities

Analysis & Insights

  • Understand business requirements and plan solutions to meet data needs
  • Conduct advanced statistical analysis and predictive modelling to surface trends and opportunities
  • Drill down into data and prepare reports with the highest level of accuracy
  • Define new KPIs and measure them consistently across datasets
  • Own and evolve the company-wide KPI framework across departments, ensuring metric definitions stay consistent and trusted

Data Modelling & Preparation

  • Design and maintain dimensional data models (fact tables, dimension tables, star schemas)
  • Collect data from multiple sources, then normalise, refine, and prepare it for analytics and visualisation
  • Partner with IT and business teams to establish data-driven policies and strategies across the organisation
  • Build and maintain data models in SQLMesh, including Jinja-templated SQL macros, following agreed modelling standards

Dashboards & Reporting

  • Design, build, test, and publish dashboards and reports on our BI platform (Apache Superset, Looker), and schedule refreshes
  • Create wireframes and beta dashboards with a focus on user experience, correctness, and visibility
  • Monitor reports and dashboards, and make changes as needed
  • Resolve data and performance issues in workbooks and data sources
  • Maintain executive-level dashboards that consolidate key metrics across departments for leadership
  • Automate recurring report delivery using workflow tools such as n8n

Platform & Governance

  • Manage BI platform implementation, architecture, and administration
  • Define access controls and implement security measures where required
  • Actively manage platform performance and usability
  • Improve processes across data management, data collection, dashboard design, and the wider product lifecycle

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of data analysts
  • Review the team's work for correctness, accuracy, and integrity
  • Set standards for analysis quality, documentation, and responsible AI usage

Qualifications

Must-haves

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience)
  • 6–8 years of experience in data analytics, including at least 2 years leading or mentoring analysts
  • Advanced SQL for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and predictive modelling
  • Expert knowledge of dimensional modelling (fact tables, dimension tables, star schemas)
  • Extensive experience building and managing dashboards and reports in BI tools such as Apache Superset, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik
  • Strong knowledge of data architecture, data mapping, data analysis, and data visualisation
  • Ability to manipulate and blend data from multiple sources to design dashboards and visualisations
  • Working proficiency with AI tools, including Claude Desktop and Claude Code, and sound judgement on responsible use

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in fintech, e-commerce, or subscription businesses
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses and modern data stack tools
  • Experience defining data access controls and governance in a BI environment
  • Experience with SQLMesh, dbt, or similar data transformation tools
  • Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n
  • Strong plus: Python for data manipulation, statistical analysis, predictive modelling, and automation

name: Data & AI Engineer
description_html:
Company Overview

Wego is an online travel metasearch platform used by millions to find the best flights and hotel deals. We are seeking a talented, agile Marketing Automation & AI Engineer with a strong focus on Agentic AI to join our MarTech team.

Role Description

As part of the Marketing Technology (MarTech) team, you will build the next generation of marketing automation — designing and deploying autonomous AI agents that drive insights from digital campaigns and independently optimize marketing operations. You will work daily alongside the Performance Marketing team, deeply understanding their KPIs (ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rates) and how media platforms work, their campaign structures, auction mechanics, and APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Apple Search Ads) to ensure every system you build directly serves campaign performance goals.

Unlike traditional, rigid backend data roles focused solely on static data lakes, this position requires building highly adaptable, configuration-driven automation systems. You will design architectures that allow the Performance Marketing team to quickly pivot campaign strategies, creative assets, and budget pacing without needing structural core code deployments for every minor requirement change.

Key Responsibilities

  • Campaign Creation & Optimization Automation: Architect end-to-end automated workflows for campaign creation, audience segmentation, creative assembly, launch, and continuous optimization using AI/ML signals to drive dynamic bidding, budget pacing, and A/B testing across channels.
  • AI-Driven Content Orchestration: Engineer multi-agent systems to generate and iterate on personalized ad content (ad copy, images, videos) at scale.
  • Agile Data Activation & Automation Infrastructure: Build and maintain flexible data flows optimized for real-time marketing activation. Ensure data structures are explicitly designed for dynamic content generation and automated campaign adjustment rather than just static reporting or legacy ETL pipelines.
  • Performance Marketing Collaboration: Partner daily with the Performance Marketing team to translate KPIs and rapidly changing campaign objectives into technical configurations; ensure data integrity, API reliability, and consistent AI agent deployments across all paid channels.
  • Agentic Workflow Development: Design, build, and deploy autonomous AI agents using LLMs (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) for automated marketing workflows.

Qualifications

Experience & Domain Expertise

  • 3+ years in performance/digital marketing analytics and marketing automation with hands-on experience in AI engineering.
  • Deep understanding of paid/performance marketing KPIs, how media platforms work (campaign structure, auction mechanics, targeting, measurement) and their APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok), and MMP tooling (AppsFlyer, Adjust).
  • Proven experience building end-to-end campaign automation systems including programmatic campaign creation, ML-driven optimization, and automated actions via ad platform APIs.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced SQL and Python.
  • Proven experience building configuration-driven architectures or rules engines (e.g., headless CMS integrations, dynamic creative optimization tools), attribution models, and activation workflows.
  • Proficiency building and orchestrating AI agents using foundational LLMs; integrating LLMs and AI agents with external tools and APIs.

Soft Skills & Mindset

  • Extreme flexibility and comfort with ambiguity: Understands that marketing strategies pivot quickly and intentionally designs technical solutions to accommodate fluid business requirements.
  • Strong product mindset: Views the marketing team as your core "users" and builds tools that empower them to self-serve safely.
  • Excellent communication skills to seamlessly bridge technical architectures with creative marketing strategies.

name: AI Engineer
description_html:
We are looking for an AI Engineer to turn 8+ years of logistics and IoT data into real, customer-facing intelligence.

This role is not about building complex AI models.

It is about solving real business problems using data, simple logic, and AI tools — and shipping fast.

You will work closely with leadership to:

  • translate ideas into working features
  • build anomaly detection, insights, and benchmarking systems
  • deliver outputs that customers can act on immediately


What will you do?

1. Build Data-Driven Features

  • Develop features such as anomaly detection (fuel, trips, driver behavior), fleet benchmarking, and automated weekly insights.
  • Turn raw data into clear, actionable outputs.

2. Design Simple, Effective Logic

  • Start with rules, thresholds, and statistical methods.
  • Avoid overengineering — focus on usefulness over complexity.

3. Develop and Ship Fast

  • Build backend services to process data (batch or near real-time), detect anomalies or patterns, and generate insights.
  • Deliver MVPs quickly and iterate based on feedback.

4. Use AI Tools Practically

  • Use LLMs (e.g., Claude, GPT) for summarizing insights, generating explanations, and enhancing the user experience.
  • Combine AI with structured logic and data.

5. Collaborate Across Teams

  • Work with Data Engineers to access clean datasets.
  • Work with Software Engineers to integrate solutions into the product.
  • Work with Product/Leadership teams to refine use cases.


Qualifications:

Must-Have

  • Strong backend development skills (Python, Node.js, or similar)
  • Solid SQL and data manipulation experience
  • Experience working with real-world, messy datasets
  • Ability to translate business problems into technical solutions
  • Track record of building and shipping features (not just prototypes)

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with: anomaly detection or time-series data, logistics / IoT datasets
  • Familiarity with: LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), basic statistical methods
  • Experience working in fast-paced, product-driven environments

name: Senior Data Analyst
description_html:
Job Description

Job ID: MJ000257

About Traveloka

Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region.

We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that.

About The Team

The Travel Activities team builds the part of the trip people actually remember — attraction tickets, guided tours, cruises, and local experiences across Southeast Asia and beyond. Data is how we make sense of it. Each product category has its own funnel and the supply landscape is fragmented, so the numbers are never clean and the answers are never obvious. That is exactly where you come in.

As part of the data analytics team, you turn millions of bookings, searches, and partner feeds into decisions our commercial and product teams act on the same week. You design the metrics, build the dashboards people actually trust, and dig into why a category is moving — not just that it is. We are deploying AI to scale this faster. If you want your analysis to change what gets sold to real travelers, this is the place.

About The Job

As a Senior Data Analyst on Traveloka’s Travel Activities team, you are an expert individual contributor — no direct reports — who independently owns the toughest, most ambiguous analytics problems in your area, accountable for the analytical decisions you make and increasingly setting the standard others follow.

  • Own the analytics agenda for the Travel Activities business area, deciding which questions are worth answering and being accountable for the recommendations that follow.
  • Lead complex, custom analyses — causal inference, advanced segmentation, funnel optimisation — on problems that span your own and adjacent job areas and that senior leaders use to set direction.
  • Improve how experimentation is done for your area as part of project teams, raising the rigour bar on how hypotheses are framed and results are read.
  • Build the foundational dashboards, metric definitions, and pipelines that other analysts and business teams depend on, applying deep, well-developed expertise built from theory and experience.
  • Persuade and convince senior stakeholders — GMs, Directors, VPs — of your reading of the evidence, even where the final decision rests with them.
  • Mentor and guide junior analysts and review their work to lift quality, without taking on line-management of a team.
  • Set technical direction for the analytical methods and tooling your peers adopt, leading through expertise rather than headcount.

Job Requirements

  • You have at least 4 years of relevant experience.
  • You have deep, demonstrated expertise in SQL and design efficient data models, queries, and pipelines that others build on — not just one-off analyses.
  • You are fluent in Python or R for advanced analytics: causal inference, segmentation, and predictive modelling, and automation that go well beyond what SQL alone can do.
  • You are an expert with BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Domo) and set the standard for what a trustworthy, decision-grade dashboard looks like across your team.
  • You independently tackle genuinely ambiguous, high-stakes problems — causal inference, funnel and pricing optimisation — choosing the right method rather than the familiar one.
  • You design and interpret experiments rigorously: power analysis, failure modes, advanced methods, and the ability to defend or challenge a result under scrutiny from a skeptical leader.
  • You influence senior, non-technical stakeholders — Managers, Directors, GMs, and VPs — translating complex analysis into strategy and decisions they act on.
  • You mentor and lift the quality of analysts around you through example and guidance, as a senior individual contributor, without needing line management authority.
  • You hold a degree in a quantitative discipline — Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or Economics — or have equivalent depth proven across several years of high-impact data work.
  • You bring strong business acumen and domain depth: you understand the unit economics of Travel Activities well enough to anticipate what the business should be asking, not just answer what it does.
  • You are fluent on a cloud data platform (BigQuery, Redshift, or Snowflake) and have worked with modern transformation tooling such as dbt.
  • You use AI and modern analytics tooling to multiply your own output and set clear norms for how your team validates what those tools produce.
  • You communicate with executive-level clarity and authority in English — in writing, in a room, and across technical and non-technical audiences.

Join Us

If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you.

We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days.

We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.

name: Senior Data Analyst, Compliance
description_html:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

The Enterprise Data Analytics (EDA) team, part of Grab's Analytics function, owns the data behind Grab's regulatory obligations across Southeast Asia. We build and run the data pipelines that produce regulatory reports for financial regulators, including OJK and Bank Indonesia, Bank Negara Malaysia, the Monetary Authority of Singapore, Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas and the Bank of Thailand. We also support AML transaction monitoring and regulatory audits, working closely with Country Compliance, AML and Fraud, Risk, Finance and Engineering. Our numbers go to regulators, so accuracy, traceability and on-time delivery come first.

Get to Know the Role

As the Senior Data Analyst, you will be the analytics owner of regulatory reporting for Grab's e-money, payments and P2P lending businesses in Indonesia. You will take each report end to end, from interpreting the regulation to delivering a validated output to Compliance for submission, and be the go-to person when Compliance, auditors or regulators ask how a number was produced. You will report into the Analytics Manager, Compliance, and work onsite at our Jakarta office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • You will take end-to-end ownership of daily, weekly and monthly regulatory reports for OJK, Bank Indonesia and industry bodies, such as SLIK, Pusdafil, APOLO and fintech data centre reporting, delivering them accurately and on time.
  • You will translate new and changed regulations into documented data requirements, definitions and pipeline changes, agreeing the interpretation with Compliance before go-live.
  • You will reconcile regulatory outputs against Finance records and across related reports, find the root cause of discrepancies, and automate data-quality checks to replace manual reconciliation.
  • You will build and maintain reliable, reproducible reporting pipelines on Airflow and Spark, and resolve failures and source-data changes before submission deadlines.
  • You will assess the reporting impact of product launches, system migrations and source-data changes, and partner with Engineering to test them before cut-over.
  • You will provide traceable, transaction-level analysis for regulatory audits, regulator data requests and AML transaction monitoring.
  • You will communicate data issues and their impact to mid-to-senior Compliance, Finance and Risk partners, and mentor junior analysts on reporting best practices.
  • You will build AI tools and self-serve solutions that speed up report development and validation, while keeping confidential data protected.

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • You have at least 4 years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence or Data Science in regulatory reporting, compliance or risk at a FinTech company or Financial Institution.
  • You have a Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering or related fields.
  • You are proficient in writing advanced SQL queries (Presto, Spark SQL or Hive) on large datasets, and in Python for automating analysis and data pipelines.
  • You have hands-on experience building and operating scheduled data pipelines with Airflow or a similar orchestrator.
  • You have a strong track record of reconciliations and data-quality controls, and can trace a discrepancy across systems to its source.
  • You have working knowledge of Indonesian financial regulation and reporting (OJK, Bank Indonesia or AFPI) or of AML/CFT data.
  • You can turn regulatory text into clear data logic and explain it to non-technical partners such as compliance officers and auditors.
  • Full professional working proficiency in English is required, on top of fluency in Bahasa Indonesia.

Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

name: BI & Data Warehouse Analyst
description_html:
We’re Hiring: BI & Data Warehouse Analyst | RAIA GRID

RAIA GRID, a subsidiary of Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison, is looking for a BI & Data Warehouse Analyst to build and manage our analytical data foundation and turn data into reliable business insights.

In this role, you will design and maintain our data warehouse, develop data pipelines, and deliver reporting that teams can trust and use. You will also apply AI and machine learning to support forecasting, anomaly detection, and natural-language querying, while building the data foundation these capabilities need.


Let's be part of smarter network!


Job Description

Requirement definition and metric ownership

  • Work with business owners to turn vague reporting requests into defined metrics, each with an agreed calculation, an owner, and a stated purpose.
  • Maintain a single business glossary so terms such as active customer, churn, utilisation, or revenue mean one thing across every report.
  • Challenge requests that duplicate existing reports, and retire dashboards nobody opens.

Data warehouse design and development

  • Design and maintain dimensional models — facts, dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions — that survive changes in the source systems behind them.
  • Maintain a layered warehouse structure with clear rules about what belongs in staging, integration, and presentation, and enforce those rules.
  • Model data from BSS, OSS, network inventory, and finance systems into one coherent view, rather than mirroring source schemas into the warehouse.

Pipeline development and operation

  • Build and schedule ELT pipelines from operational sources, including incremental loads and handling of late-arriving or corrected data.
  • Monitor pipeline runs, investigate failures, and reprocess without creating duplicates or silently dropping records.
  • Keep transformation logic in version control and under test, not scattered across ad hoc scripts.

Reporting and self-service enablement

  • Build reports and dashboards that answer a specific decision, each with a named audience and a defined refresh frequency.
  • Tune semantic models and queries so reports open quickly enough that people actually use them.
  • Prepare governed datasets so business teams can answer their own questions, instead of building every report on request.

AI-enabled analytics

  • Identify where AI genuinely improves an analytics outcome — forecasting, anomaly detection, classification of free-text, natural-language querying — and where conventional reporting already answers the question.
  • Deliver AI-assisted analytics use cases end to end, from problem definition through to a result the business acts on.
  • Build and maintain the data foundation AI depends on: clean, documented, well-modelled datasets and a semantic layer that lets a model query them reliably.
  • Establish how output quality is measured before anyone is asked to trust it, including a baseline to compare against.
  • Work with the AI automation function on shared standards and tooling, so the company does not end up with two conflicting approaches to AI.

Data quality and governance

  • Define and automate data quality checks covering completeness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and reconciliation against source systems.
  • Publish lineage so that any number in a report can be traced back to where it came from.
  • Apply access controls and the requirements of UU PDP 27/2022 wherever personal data is involved, including masking in non-production environments.

Stakeholder engagement

  • Present findings honestly to non-technical audiences, including what the data cannot tell them and how confident the numbers are.
  • Investigate and resolve disputes about the numbers — where two reports disagree, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Document models and metric definitions so the knowledge does not live only in one person's head.


Job Requirements

We care that you can build a warehouse people trust, not that you have used a specific product. Equivalent tools and experience are welcome.

  • SQL: Advanced — window functions, CTEs, query tuning, and the ability to read an execution plan rather than guess at performance.
  • Data modelling: Kimball dimensional modelling to a production standard; familiarity with Data Vault or wide-table approaches and a view on when each fits.
  • ELT and transformation: At least one framework such as dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, SSIS, Talend, Pentaho, or equivalent.
  • BI platforms: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Metabase or equivalent — including semantic modelling such as DAX or LookML, not only building charts. Power BI is directly relevant to our environment.
  • Databases: Relational databases, plus a columnar or MPP warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Synapse, or ClickHouse.
  • Programming: Python for data work; Git for everything that is not a one-off query.
  • Orchestration and operations: Scheduling, dependency management, monitoring, and alerting on pipeline failures.
  • Cloud: At least one major cloud, with an understanding of how storage and compute costs behave as data volume grows.
  • Data quality: A concrete method for testing and monitoring data correctness. This is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • Machine learning: Applied ML for analytics problems — forecasting, classification, anomaly detection — using standard libraries such as scikit-learn, statsmodels, or Prophet.
  • LLMs in analytics: Hands-on with at least one LLM provider API, including experience exposing warehouse data to a model safely via semantic layer, generated SQL, or retrieval over documentation.
  • AI system implementation: Experience taking an AI component from prototype to something that runs on a schedule, is monitored, and has an owner — covering deployment, versioning, and refresh or retraining strategy.

Valuable, not required: streaming pipelines with Kafka; data catalogue and lineage tooling; geospatial and GIS concepts in a network context; telecommunications domain data; finance reporting experience; MLOps practices; vector stores and embedding-based search; semantic layer tooling such as dbt Semantic Layer or Cube.


Experience & Qualifications

  • 5–8 years in business intelligence, data warehousing, or analytics engineering. Equivalent practical experience is accepted in place of a specific degree.
  • Minimum 3 years building and maintaining a data warehouse in production — not only reporting on top of one that someone else built.
  • Hands-on dimensional modelling experience, with a considered view on when to depart from it.
  • Ownership of at least one reporting platform used regularly by business users, including handling complaints when the numbers looked wrong.
  • Experience reconciling data across several operational source systems that disagreed with each other.
  • Delivered at least one AI or machine learning use case that reached regular business use — for example capacity forecasting, anomaly detection, text classification, or natural-language querying over warehouse data — and able to explain how accuracy was measured and what it was compared against.
  • Practical experience using large language models in an analytics workflow, with a clear view of where they add nothing and a simpler method is better.
  • Experience in telecommunications, utilities, or another asset-heavy industry is an advantage, not a requirement.

name: Senior Credit Risk Analyst
description_html:
Funding Societies | Modalku is the largest SME digital finance platform in Southeast Asia. We are licensed and operating in Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and Vietnam, and backed by Sequoia India (Peak XV), Softbank Vision Fund, Khazanah and SMBC bank amongst many others. Funding Societies | Modalku provides business financing to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), which is funded by individual and institutional investors, as well as payments solutions to SMEs and consumers.

Here at Funding Societies | Modalku we live by our core values GETFS:

  • Grow Relentlessly: Strive to become our best, most authentic selves.
  • Enable Teamwork, Disable Politics: Only by forging togetherness, we help each other succeed.
  • Test Measure Act: Stay curious and reinvent ourselves, through innovation and experimentation.
  • Focus on Impact: Create impact through bias for action and tangible results.
  • Serve with Obsession: Build win-win relationships for the long-term by having a customer obsession.

TA key hire for our Credit Risk team, you will report to the Regional Head of Credit Risk and take ownership of how we read our loan portfolio — from vintage performance and borrower/industry concentration to early-warning trends. This goes beyond running the numbers: you'll be expected to exercise judgment on what's genuinely significant and make clear, actionable recommendations that the credit risk team and senior stakeholders can act on.

What You Will Do

Portfolio Analytics

  • NPL and delinquency trend analysis (such as DPD bucket flow rates and migration, vintage analysis) to track credit quality
  • Recovery and write-off performance tracking, including legacy vs. current book splits
  • Portfolio concentration analysis by borrower, industry, product, and country exposures
  • ECL/provisioning coverage analysis and explaining what's driving month-on-month movement
  • Monthly monitoring of key portfolio risk metrics against Risk Appetite Statement (RAS) thresholds, including root-cause analysis of breaches and recommendations for improvement
  • Applying trend/statistical checks to flag unusual movements early (vs. normal noise)
  • Maintaining data accuracy and reconciliation across source systems and country teams
  • Explaining the "why" behind portfolio movements, not just reporting the numbers

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Responding to ad hoc data requests from country teams or finance
  • Working with country credit teams to validate local data and portfolio context
  • Collaborating with the data science/analytics team on scorecards or risk models
  • Liaising with collections/recovery teams on NPL resolution status
  • Supporting fraud-adjacent credit risk flags where cases sit at the fraud/credit boundary

Process & Governance

  • Preparing monthly/quarterly credit risk packs and dashboards
  • Helping maintain documentation for the credit risk monitoring framework and methodology
  • Preparing materials for Board Risk Committee (BRC) and senior management reviews

Requirements

What we are looking for:

  • Have a Bachelor's Degree or above in Statistics/Finance/Economics/Engineering/Analytics or similar from a University
  • At least 6-8 years of experience in credit risk analytics
  • Familiar with local regulations and data landscape in the ASEAN region
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills
  • Advanced working knowledge of MS Excel, including pivot tables and building vintage/cohort analyses
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and ability to work with large amounts of data; working knowledge of Python is an advantage
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted tools to support analysis, reporting, and productivity
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment, navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities

  • Medical benefits - We offer health insurance coverage for our employees and dependents. Our people focus on our mission knowing we have their backs for their loved ones too.
  • Mental health and wellness - We understand that our team productivity is directly linked to our mental and physical health. Hence we organize org-wide fitness initiatives and engage partners to provide well-being coaching.
  • Tech support - We provide a company laptop for our employees and the best possible support for the right equipment/tools to enable high productivity

name: Pricing Analyst
description_html:
Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.

Cinch is Southeast Asia’s leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle. We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends — sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access — creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption. At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we’re creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers — and where the work has real, lasting impact.

The Role

Pricing decides whether a subscription device makes money. As our Pricing Analyst you will be the protector of yield and margin: you will measure what our fleet actually earns by market, segment and product type, price new launches, drive our residual value analysis, and make sure every special deal and promotion still makes money.

You will work closely with Commercial, Growth, Marketing and Asset Operations, and with the Corporate Finance Director, who owns pricing strategy.

What You'll Own

  • Yield analysis. Track gross yield across the portfolio by market, product type, tenure and customer segment, comparing old versus new pricing and first versus subsequent lease cycles. Explain what moved yield and recommend what to do about it.
  • New launch pricing. Price new devices and product launches by market, reset the price ladder for prior generations, and track post-launch performance against the original pricing case.
  • Residual value analysis. Drive residual value analysis by market, device and age. Compare realised resale and re-let values against our assumptions and feed the results back into pricing.
  • Residual value counterparties. Work with Asset Operations on discussions with buy-back, trade-in and resale counterparties, bringing the residual value benchmarks and economics behind each negotiation.
  • Special deal and promotion pricing. Partner with Growth and Marketing on campaigns, partner offers and special deals. Find the structure that hits the commercial goal while protecting margin, and set clear guardrails on what can be discounted and by how much.
  • Pricing models. Build and maintain the models that set subscription rates by device, tenure, market and channel. Inputs include device cost, financing cost, expected residual value, refurbishment, logistics, credit loss and servicing cost.
  • Deal pricing support. Turn around pricing and margin analysis for B2B, partner and enterprise deals quickly, with a clear recommendation and the trade-offs.
  • Margin tracking. Monitor realised yield and margin against plan by product, channel and cohort. Flag leakage from discounts, promos, early returns and write-offs.
  • Market and competitor benchmarking. Track competitor and market pricing in each country we operate in, including local currency and tax effects.
  • Experiments. Design and read price tests and promotion results, and recommend what to keep.
  • Pricing governance. Keep one price book, a clear discount approval matrix and a log of every price change and why it was made.

What You Bring

Must-have

  • 2 to 4 years in pricing, FP&A, commercial finance, strategy or consulting, with real financial modelling experience.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, and working SQL or willingness to learn it quickly.
  • Comfortable with margin maths: contribution margin, cost of funds, breakeven and sensitivity analysis.
  • Curious and analytical. You enjoy digging into data to find out why a number moved, and you keep going until you have the answer.
  • Commercial instinct with discipline. You can work with Growth and Marketing to get a deal done, and say no, with numbers, when it gives away margin.
  • Degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering or a related field.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience in subscription, leasing, rental, lending, BNPL or consumer electronics.
  • Exposure to residual value, used-device or secondary-market pricing.
  • Experience with price testing, elasticity analysis or demand modelling.
  • Familiarity with BI tools and basic Python or R.
  • Exposure to more than one Southeast Asian market, or to the Middle East.

Join our Strategy & Transformation team and play a key role in driving ESSA’s data and analytics agenda. As a Data Strategy Analyst, you will identify high-impact data use cases, develop strategic KPI frameworks, and translate business priorities into actionable analytics initiatives that support executive decision-making, business transformation, and measurable performance improvement.

PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk, formerly known as PT Surya Esa Perkasa Tbk., underwent a transformative rebrand in 2022 to better align with its vision of leading Indonesia's drive towards world-class industrialization. Established in 2006, the company initially ventured into LPG and Condensate production with its refinery facility in Palembang. Over the years, it expanded its operations, notably entering the Ammonia production sector through its subsidiary, PT Panca Amara Utama, at the Banggai Ammonia Plant in Sulawesi Tengah. ESSA has evolved into a leading company committed to contributing to Indonesia's world-class industrialization processes. The company places a strong emphasis on environmental, social, and sustainability considerations in all its endeavors. With records of accomplishment of innovation and excellence, ESSA continues to play a pivotal role in shaping Indonesia's industrial landscape.

description_html:

  • Cross-functional facilitation, project oversight, and guidance to site controllers.

name: GoTo Financial - Senior Risk Analyst - Gopay Lending
description_html:
About The Role

This role is central to our Credit Risk Strategy for merchant lending products including Gopay Pinjam Modal (GPPM) and Toko Kapital. Key challenges include balancing portfolio growth with risk mitigation and navigating complex merchant data to inform actionable decisions.

The person will be expected to assist in managing credit underwriting and account management. In order to support the deliverables, this person is also expected to quickly learn internal risk frameworks, establish relationships with key business stakeholders, and contribute to risk analysis and strategy execution.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor and analyze key merchant risk metrics to uncover underlying trends and provide actionable insights.
  • Evaluate and optimize current credit risk policies to ensure robust portfolio health and risk mitigation.
  • Leverage SQL and Python to analyze complex datasets, driving continuous strategy enhancements and executing them via decision engines.
  • Partner with cross-functional business teams to guide and support data-driven lending decisions.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive risk dashboards to facilitate accurate, real-time reporting for stakeholders.
  • Facilitate periodic credit reviews and internal audits to ensure compliance and uphold risk standards.
  • Drive process improvement initiatives within the Credit Risk team to enhance overall operational efficiency.

What You Will Need

  • At least 3 years of experience in credit risk management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Understanding of credit risk principles and lending products.
  • Experience with data analysis tools (SQL/PYTHON, Excel, or BI tools).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks.

About The Team

As a pivotal member of the Credit Risk function, this role manages merchant lending products, monitors portfolio health, and ensures policy compliance. A central objective is to strategically balance business growth with risk mitigation through the interpretation of complex merchant data.

About GoTo Group

GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.

The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

Discover more by following us on LinkedIn!

 

Your #FutureInSight with EssilorLuxottica

Your expertise will help drive the adoption and optimal use of our products, ensuring improved outcomes and satisfaction collaboration with various stakeholders.

Planning & Forecasting 

  • Lead budget and forecast cycles, including periodic reforecasts, monthly phasing, and year-end estimates.

Performance Analysis & Reporting

PT Kredit Biro Indonesia Jaya (Credit Bureau Indonesia, “CBI”) as one of the private credit bureaus in Indonesia has been established since 2014 and obtained an operational license from Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) as Lembaga Pengelola Informasi Perkreditan (LPIP) in 2015.

Role Overview

As a Data Management Engineer ,you will investigate, analyze, and resolve credit data issues and disputes to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and compliance with regulatory requirements. Responsibilities include analyzing data from databases and other sources, monitoring dispute resolution within SLA, preparing reports, and collaborating with internal teams, clients, data contributors, and regulatory bodies such as OJK.   • Prepare and maintain dispute resolution reports for internal and external stakeholders (OJK, clients).
  • Analyze data contributions, prepare reports, and address feedback from members.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field with 3–5 years of experience in data analysis or the financial industry preferred.

  • Proficient in SQL for data analysis; knowledge of programming (e.g., Python) and reporting tools is an advantage.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for effective reporting and collaboration.
  • Familiarity with regulatory compliance, data privacy, and credit reporting standards.
  • Excellent multitasking and organizational skills to meet deadlines in high-pressure situations.

We seek a detail-oriented analyst who excels at translating complex data into effective strategies. This is a full-time, on-site role reporting to the Manager.

  • Data Management & Dashboard Creation: Gather and organize data from multiple sources to build dashboards for churn monitoring, sales performance tracking, and market analysis.

Qualifications

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, CS) with 3+ years of experience in data analysis or business intelligence. Experience in tech or sales operations is an added value.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI) for building dashboards. Experience with Python or R is advantageous.

name: Senior Data  Analytics Manager (Remote)
description_html:
Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.

Cinch is Southeast Asia's leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle.

We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends—sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access—creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption.

At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we're creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers—and where the work has real, lasting impact.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analytics Manager to lead data-driven decision-making at Cinch. You will analyse complex datasets, identify trends, and turn them into strategic insights that improve business performance.

You will design and implement data models, build dashboards, and partner with cross-functional teams and leadership. The role involves advanced statistical analysis, predictive modelling, and data visualisation using SQL (Python is a strong plus), alongside extensive hands-on experience with BI tools. You should be an expert in dimensional modelling, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas.

This is a team lead and individual contributor role. You will manage a team of data analysts, mentor and coach them, and review their work for correctness and integrity before it reaches the business.

You are also expected to be AI-literate and comfortable working with both Claude Desktop and Claude Code. We expect responsible AI usage, and the correctness of all work submitted remains the analyst's own responsibility.

Responsibilities

Analysis & Insights

  • Understand business requirements and plan solutions to meet data needs
  • Conduct advanced statistical analysis and predictive modelling to surface trends and opportunities
  • Drill down into data and prepare reports with the highest level of accuracy
  • Define new KPIs and measure them consistently across datasets
  • Own and evolve the company-wide KPI framework across departments, ensuring metric definitions stay consistent and trusted

Data Modelling & Preparation

  • Design and maintain dimensional data models (fact tables, dimension tables, star schemas)
  • Collect data from multiple sources, then normalise, refine, and prepare it for analytics and visualisation
  • Partner with IT and business teams to establish data-driven policies and strategies across the organisation
  • Build and maintain data models in SQLMesh, including Jinja-templated SQL macros, following agreed modelling standards

Dashboards & Reporting

  • Design, build, test, and publish dashboards and reports on our BI platform (Apache Superset, Looker), and schedule refreshes
  • Create wireframes and beta dashboards with a focus on user experience, correctness, and visibility
  • Monitor reports and dashboards, and make changes as needed
  • Resolve data and performance issues in workbooks and data sources
  • Maintain executive-level dashboards that consolidate key metrics across departments for leadership
  • Automate recurring report delivery using workflow tools such as n8n

Platform & Governance

  • Manage BI platform implementation, architecture, and administration
  • Define access controls and implement security measures where required
  • Actively manage platform performance and usability
  • Improve processes across data management, data collection, dashboard design, and the wider product lifecycle

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of data analysts
  • Review the team's work for correctness, accuracy, and integrity
  • Set standards for analysis quality, documentation, and responsible AI usage

Qualifications

Must-haves

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience)
  • 6–8 years of experience in data analytics, including at least 2 years leading or mentoring analysts
  • Advanced SQL for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and predictive modelling
  • Expert knowledge of dimensional modelling (fact tables, dimension tables, star schemas)
  • Extensive experience building and managing dashboards and reports in BI tools such as Apache Superset, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik
  • Strong knowledge of data architecture, data mapping, data analysis, and data visualisation
  • Ability to manipulate and blend data from multiple sources to design dashboards and visualisations
  • Working proficiency with AI tools, including Claude Desktop and Claude Code, and sound judgement on responsible use

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in fintech, e-commerce, or subscription businesses
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses and modern data stack tools
  • Experience defining data access controls and governance in a BI environment
  • Experience with SQLMesh, dbt, or similar data transformation tools
  • Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n
  • Strong plus: Python for data manipulation, statistical analysis, predictive modelling, and automation

Amar Bank is one of the most technologically advanced digital banks in Indonesia. Our leading

digital lending product, Tunaiku has the distinction of being the first FinTech product in

Indonesia. We are also the first digital bank on the cloud. As the first profitable digital bank, we

managed to get listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange.

How did we manage to do that?

We are changing people’s perception of a bank. We believe we are the innovators who combine

customer focus principles with creating technology-based impact. We incorporate freedom and

flexibility as part of our startup working culture DNA to encourage innovation in creating better

financial solutions for the banking industry. We think of ourselves as, ‘A technology company

with a banking license’. For this reason, we ‘Act like a FinTech, and think like a Bank.’

How did it all start?

Founded on March 15, 1991, in Surabaya as PT Anglomas International Bank (Amin Bank), the

bank was acquired by Tolaram Group and transformed to PT Bank Amar Indonesia (Amar Bank)

in 2014. It has then undergone a significant digital transformation to become one of the

country's forerunning fintech institutions through its award-winning digital lending platform,

Tunaiku.

Our philosophy, mission, and vision

Technology must impact lives, must improve lives. We exist to provide banking to those who

‘need’ and not only to those who ‘want’. Services when provided to those who need at the time

of their need brings smiles. Our vision is to bring 200 million smiles.

fun at the workplace! We provide a great working environment that pushes people to grow

outside their comfort zone. People with high drive and ambition find us a very attractive place to

work as their career growth matches their own drive and not any staid policies. Thus we hold

the honor of being awarded “Best Place to Work in Indonesia”.

Recently Amar Bank was awarded as Inspirational Brand from APEA (Asia Pacific Enterprise

Awards) 2022. Of course, our innovation won't stop here. So if you would love to be a part of it,

have a growth mindset, and are constantly hungry for challenges, we invite you to join us in our

journey to ‘Impact Lives’.

Join us today and create #unlimitedinnovations!

This position is responsible end-to-end for the technical and data execution to build and maintain Compass, a business intelligence product within the Northstar app that serves as the central dashboard for MGMI's management and top leaders. The main responsibilities cover the entire data processing lifecycle, from managing data sources, processing metrics, and creating dashboards, to developing supporting applications and system maintenance.

description_html:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. Job Description

Merchant Operations is a team responsible for analyzing merchant growth and trends. We make critical decisions to serve the lives of merchant-partners and providing best offers for our consumers.

Get to Know the Role

We are looking for an Operations Analytics Lead to spearhead data-driven decision-making across our merchant strategy and control tower operations. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution—autonomously translating complex operational challenges into analytical models, automated dashboards, and actionable business insights.

You will own end-to-end analytics initiatives spanning merchant acquisition, incubation, and segmentation frameworks verticals. This is an Onsite role based in Jakarta

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Operations Analytics, or Strategy Consulting within high-growth tech, e-commerce, or on-demand platforms.

Life at Grab

  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

name: Business and Data Analyst - Social Commerce SME
description_html:
Who We Are

Intrepid Asia is a leading Ecommerce and Digital Solutions Provider in South East Asia. We offer end-to-end omni-channel ecommerce management, Livestreaming, Video production & Affiliate Management for Social Commerce, plus full funnel Digital Marketing Services and advanced Market Intelligence, all powered by state-of-the-art in-house Technology to our client base of leading international brands across all key marketplaces and social platforms in all 6 SEA countries. Brands love our regional presence, our excellent data-driven, growth-focused services, enabled by the industry's strongest team, and our advanced marketing and tech capabilities.

We are growing rapidly, and as the exclusive partner of Flywheel in SEA, we offer many exciting opportunities to work with leading brands across multiple categories and key industry players. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful ecommerce business end-to-end.

The Role

We are looking for a BA/DA — Social Commerce to become Intrepid's dedicated social commerce analytics subject-matter expert across the region, based in the Philippines, while acting as the go-to social commerce domain resource for country teams across all six SEA markets we operate in.

This is a hybrid role by design. You will own social commerce analytics requirements end-to-end — discovering what country livestream, affiliate, and content teams actually need, translating it into a solvable data problem, and then doing the hands-on SQL, dashboard, and reconciliation work yourself, working hand-in-hand with our central Data Engineering and BI team (based in Vietnam and Indonesia) in a hub-and-spoke model. You are not a traditional, non-technical BA who hands off requirements and waits — nor a pure data analyst who builds what's asked without questioning it. You are the person who connects livestream performance, affiliate and creator economics, and content-to-conversion outcomes into one picture, and who is experienced enough to surface signals nobody has thought to ask about yet.

The world is moving past the era of the static dashboard. Stakeholders no longer just want a chart to interpret — they want AI-native, proactive insight: analytics that surfaces what matters before anyone has to go looking for it, flags anomalies and drivers automatically, and arrives with a narrative and a recommendation attached, not just a number. In social commerce, that matters even more — a livestream session or a piece of content can succeed or fail in real time, and a report delivered the next morning is often a report delivered too late. We want this role to help lead that shift inside Intrepid's social commerce domain, not simply maintain the reporting model it's replacing.

You will work directly with data flowing through Intrepid's socom platform, our internal system of record for livestream, affiliate, and content performance, as well as social commerce data crawled or pulled via official API from TikTok Shop, Shopee Live, and Lazada Live, and third-party market intelligence and digital shelf data. Data accuracy has been a real, active challenge for our dashboards; this role is central to closing that gap for the social commerce domain specifically — and to reimagining what social commerce reporting looks like once it isn't just a dashboard anymore.

Key Responsibilities2. Analysis & Solutioning — Domain and Technical3. Insight Delivery & Stakeholder Management4. Governance, Documentation & Scale5. AI-Native Analytics & Proactive Insight Generation

  • Discovery & Requirements
  • Lead requirement-gathering conversations and workshops with livestream, affiliate, and content stakeholders, and support country social commerce leads across all six SEA markets
  • Map how social commerce data flows across the socom platform and creator/affiliate/content sources, to identify what a country team actually needs versus what they're asking for
  • Translate open-ended questions (e.g. "why did last night's livestream underperform versus last week's") into concrete, structured data requirements
  • Maintain a prioritized backlog of social commerce analytics requests, working the hub-and-spoke model with the central Data Engineering / BI team in Vietnam and Indonesia
  • Own end-to-end social commerce analytics: livestream session performance, affiliate/creator ROI and commission economics, and content-to-conversion funnel analysis
  • Write your own SQL and build/validate your own dashboards rather than fully depending on the central BI team — pairing with a Vietnam- or Indonesia-based analyst for heavier pipeline or engineering work
  • Validate and reconcile socom platform numbers, escalating recurring data quality issues to the central Data Governance & Quality function
  • Interpret third-party market intelligence and digital shelf vendor data for competitive livestream and creator context, understanding the strengths and known limitations of each data source
  • Present livestream, affiliate, and content performance insights directly to country social commerce leads and regional leadership — not just a finished dashboard, but a point of view on what to do next
  • Proactively surface non-obvious patterns across markets, creators, and content formats, rather than only answering questions as they're asked
  • Act as the social commerce domain's voice within Data & Analytics, feeding requirements into the central data engineering roadmap — including Intrepid's ongoing move from crawled Seller Centre data to official platform APIs for social commerce metrics
  • Maintain social commerce-specific metric definitions (e.g. livestream GMV, viewer engagement, creator commission), feeding into Intrepid's broader BI Business Glossary and semantic layer
  • Document social commerce metric methodology to ensure consistency of definitions across all six markets
  • Contribute to social commerce data quality monitoring, flagging recurring issues as candidates for automation
  • Use AI tools such as Claude to move social commerce reporting from reactive, next-morning dashboard-pulls toward proactive, near-real-time insight — automated commentary, anomaly detection on live sessions, and "so what" summaries generated alongside the numbers
  • Prototype and pilot AI-assisted analytics workflows — real-time livestream anomaly alerts, automated creator/affiliate performance summaries, natural-language querying over social commerce data — in partnership with the central Data Engineering team
  • Continuously evaluate where GenAI can replace manual, repetitive reporting effort within the social commerce domain, and hand off validated use cases into Intrepid's broader AI transformation and automation roadmap

Requirements

Technical & Data Capabilities

  • Hands-on SQL and dashboarding experience (e.g. Apache Superset, Looker, Power BI, or similar), with the ability to validate and reconcile data from multiple sources yourself
  • Working knowledge of social/live commerce data structures — livestream session metrics, affiliate/creator commission models, and content-to-conversion funnels
  • Experience with or exposure to live commerce and social platform data (TikTok Shop, Shopee Live, Lazada Live) is a strong plus
  • Comfort working with third-party vendor datasets (market intelligence, digital shelf) and reconciling discrepancies between sources
  • Genuine, hands-on experience using Claude or other GenAI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini) for real analytical work — generating and debugging SQL, summarizing large or messy datasets, drafting stakeholder-ready insight narratives — not just casual or occasional use
  • Comfort experimenting with AI agents or no/low-code workflow automation tools (e.g. n8n) to prototype proactive, always-on insight generation rather than one-off, on-request dashboard pulls
  • Working prompt-engineering literacy — able to get reliable, decision-useful analytical output from an AI tool, and to know when to trust it and when to verify it

Social Commerce Domain & Business Analyst Capabilities

  • Deep understanding of live commerce mechanics: livestream selling, affiliate/creator economics, and content-driven conversion
  • Strong requirements-gathering and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate with minimal oversight across multiple country social commerce teams
  • Ability to connect content and creator investment to commerce outcomes into a single, coherent narrative for leadership
  • Excellent communication skills, able to bridge business/social commerce and technical/data audiences

Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of combined experience across social/live commerce analytics, business analysis, or data analysis roles
  • Prior experience in live commerce, TikTok Shop, or the creator economy in Southeast Asia
  • Experience covering multiple markets or countries remotely from a regional hub
  • Exposure to affiliate/creator management platforms or livestream analytics tools
  • Prior experience building or piloting an AI-assisted or automated reporting/insight workflow, even informally, is a strong plus

Why Join Intrepid

  • Shape social commerce analytics for a leading e-commerce enabler operating across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vietnam
  • Be the first dedicated social commerce SME in this role, shaping how the function operates region-wide from the ground up
  • Help lead Intrepid's shift from static, next-day dashboards to AI-native, proactive social commerce insight — you'll be defining what that looks like, not inheriting someone else's legacy reporting model
  • Work directly with real livestream, affiliate, and content data flowing through Intrepid's own socom platform — not theoretical frameworks

Benefits

In return, you will be getting

  • We are building 'the operating system for digital commerce in South East Asia' covering all key platforms, working with leading international brands, with a breadth and depth of functionalities (Middleware, OMS, Inventory mgmt, Store Ops, CX, MarTech, Data & Analytics) that few in the industry can match
  • You get the chance to work on exciting SaaS projects and sophisticated features and functionalities that will make a big impact in the industry, on a top-notch scalable infrastructure
  • Our Tech team has been around since 2017, so you will join a well-oiled and stable "machine" (= rockstar expert team), where processes are well established and enterprise-grade. But at the same time, our organisation is non-hierarchical, entrepreneurial and collaborative, and working on cool stuff, so you get the best of both worlds
  • Tech is a strategic pillar for intrepid, so you will feel the love and recognition for your work, and will partner closely with business stakeholders, who as internal users of the tech will provide the real-world feedback and inputs which help to take our tech stack to the next level

We also offer

Best of Both Worlds

We are a scale up: the sophistication of a small multinational, with the agility of a start-up. This means you get to work on cutting-edge projects, and besides your 'standard' job description, we love to see you show entrepreneurial initiative and want to see your take on how you can take your role and our company to the next level. Good ideas get implemented. You are the master of your own destiny.

Culture that Brings Out the Best

At Intrepid, culture is not just a buzzword, it is what we practice at work every day. We believe in collaboration over competition, transparency over politics, and willingness to learn over ego. You will be part of a team where people genuinely support one another, celebrate wins together, and face challenges head-on as one. We put our all into the work but we balance it with fun, whether that is through team lunches, after-work hangouts, events or shared laughter in the office. This is a place where you can thrive professionally while having a great time.

Grow Without Limits

Learning at Intrepid is constant and dynamic. You will have access to formal training through face-to-face sessions, coaching and our very own Intrepid Academy. On top of that, real-world experience such as leading clients, working with advanced tech, and mastering best-in-class processes will accelerate your growth every step of the way. Surrounded by a talented team that raises the bar daily, in a rapidly growing and ever-expanding business, the opportunities for your development are endless.

Rewarding You Right

We believe great work deserves great rewards at Intrepid. That's why we offer competitive compensation and generous benefits, including comprehensive insurance and ample leave, to support you both in and out of the workplace. We want you to feel valued, cared for, and empowered to bring your best self to work every day.

Note: We will not be accepting any unsolicited resumes or CVs from headhunting or recruitment agencies at this point. Any CVs or profiles shared with us will not be entertained, and in the event of dispute, Intrepid will not be liable for any material compensation to third parties
