Pengelolaan Deployment: Melaksanakan proses deployment platform data pipeline, meliputi tahap pre-check, deployment execution, hingga post-deployment monitoring untuk memastikan kualitas dan keberhasilan deployment.

Pemeliharaan & Optimasi Sistem

Melakukan deep dive analysis terkait performa sistem data pipeline dan database, mencakup configuration tuning, table, index, jobs, dan query.

Melakukan pengecekan detail pada object platform dan database untuk mengidentifikasi potensi masalah serta menentukan solusi permanen maupun langkah perbaikan berkelanjutan.

Penyelesaian Masalah (Troubleshooting): Penanganan troubleshooting tingkat lanjut dan perbaikan insiden pada pipeline logic, OS & server, storage, serta jaringan dan konektivitas.

Analisis Tren & Otomasi

Menganalisis tren performa dan penggunaan sistem (data growth, job relation & dependency, data flow, resource utilization) serta menyusun rencana peningkatan performa (improvement).

Menguasai proses otomasi (monitoring, alert, notification, analisis) dan penyesuaian performa (performance tuning) pada sistem, database, maupun server.

Dokumentasi & Transfer Knowledge: Menyusun serta memperbarui prosedur operasional, mendokumentasikan change management pada tracker, dan memberikan bimbingan (transfer knowledge) kepada tim Junior.

Pelaporan & Komunikasi: Menyusun dan mempresentasikan analisis, rekomendasi, serta wawasan (insight) terkait sistem pangkalan data kepada tim teknis maupun non-teknis.

Minimum Qualifications

Pendidikan: Minimal D3 Jurusan Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, Teknologi Informasi, Statistika, Matematika, Teknik Industri, atau bidang studi IT yang setara.

Pengalaman Kerja: Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman di bidang data operation atau development.

Infrastruktur & OS: Memiliki pengalaman dalam mengelola konfigurasi infrastruktur (server & network) serta konfigurasi OS (Linux & Windows servers).

Platform Database (Tingkat Intermediate): Menguasai platform database seperti MS SQL, PostgreSQL, IBM DB2, Elasticsearch, MariaDB, MongoDB, Apache HBase, Hive & Impala, HDFS, atau TigerGraph / Graph Database.

Query & Optimasi: Menguasai optimasi query SQL & NoSQL (database cluster & non-cluster).

Data Streaming: Menguasai operasional data streaming berbasis Confluent Kafka dan Qlik CDC.

Perangkat Operasional (Operational Tools): Terbiasa menggunakan ELK Stack, Grafana, DB Monitoring, Confluence, JIRA, dan Control-M.

Sertifikasi (Nilai Tambah): Memiliki sertifikasi seperti Control-M Basic, CDMP, Azure DP-900, SQL Intermediate, atau sertifikat data management sejenis.

name: Data Migration Specialist
description_html:
JOB DESCRIPTIONS

  • Conduct data migration meeting with client to explain how data migration process will be going
  • Prepare Data Dictionary that have explanation about table structures, data volume, formats, data quality
  • Identify data in scope for migration and data to be excluded (obsolete historical data, duplicates, etc.)
  • Define the reconciliation item agree with the client on what will be reconciled post-migration
  • Extract data from the client's legacy system according to the agreed scope and schedule
  • Coordinate with the client IT team to obtain required data access (database dump, flat file export, API, etc.)
  • Document the extraction method and ensure data integrity during the extraction process.
  • Maintain confidentiality and security of client data throughout extraction
  • Transform data per the Data Mapping Document: format conversion, reference code alignment, value normalization, and so forth
  • Cleanse data of duplicates, inconsistencies, invalid null values, and other anomalies
  • Prepare and execute validation scripts to verify completeness, accuracy, and consistency of migrated data
  • Prepare a production migration plan (rundown migration): step sequence, time estimates, and rollback procedures
  • Execute data migration to the production environment in line with the go-live schedule set by the Project Manager
  • Perform post-migration checks to confirm production data is healthy before go-live operations begin
  • Resolve data migration issue


REQUIREMENTS

  • Min. S1 in Information Systems, Computer Science, Informatics Engineering, or related field
  • Proficient in SQL for data extraction, transformation, validation, and reconciliation
  • Experienced working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or equivalent)
  • Able to read and produce technical data documentation (Data Mapping, Data Dictionary, ERD)
  • Familiarity with ETL tools (SSIS or equivalent) is a plus
  • Basic scripting ability (Python or Shell Script) for migration process automation is a plus.
  • Understanding of multifinance business processes: debtor data structures, instalment, collateral, and accounting entries is a plus
  • Familiarity with OJK reporting requirements for multifinance (SLIK, monthly OJK reports) is a plus
  • Detail oriented and structured
  • Strong analytical problem solving skill
  • Able to communicate technical finding clearly to non technical stakeholder
  • Maintains integrity and confidentiality in handling client data
  • Willing to travel and work on site at client location
  • Willing to work in weekend or after office hour according to project schedule

name: Data Scientist (Product Analytics) - Financial Services
description_html:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

GrabFin Analytics team supports the GFin product and business organisations, across Payments, Lending, Insurance, and Kios. As a Senior Data Scientist (Analytics), you will be part of the Lending tech family where we strive to be the best FinTech company in the region. Our team is focused on understanding user experiences and partnering with Business, Product, Design, and Tech teams to achieve the right outcomes. We are integral to product development, from understanding user journeys with UX designers, to developing hypotheses, through to post-rollout optimisation.

Get to Know the Role

In this role, you'll partner closely with Product Managers to turn product and business questions into clear hypotheses, thoughtfully designed experiments, and actionable insights. You'll build a deep understanding of users—their needs, pain points, and behaviours—while keeping business goals in view. As a strategic analytics partner throughout the product development lifecycle, you'll support teams from early ideation through execution, helping shape product direction and prioritize features based on evidence and expected impact.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to identify data requirements and design innovative analytical solutions or insights to address complex challenges effectively.
  • Conduct in-depth analyses of operational data, including business/impact analysis and text analysis, to identify areas for improvement and process optimization.
  • Develop dashboards to monitor the performance of Grab Support operations, support specialists, and the business overall.
  • Utilize advanced statistical and machine learning techniques, such as quasi-experimental methods, NLP & LLM, to analyze large datasets and derive meaningful insights that drive business decisions, improve support performance, and mitigate risks.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in analytics and data science, leveraging this knowledge to enhance the organization's data-driven capabilities.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data quality, integrity, and accessibility, while building data pipelines and infrastructure for analytics projects.
  • Communicate complex analytical findings to all stakeholders, including senior management, through concise reports, presentations, and visualizations.

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • A minimum of Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, or Engineering or any related field.
  • At least 2+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Science roles, preferably in an Internet or "Direct-to-Consumer" company with large, complex, high-velocity data.
  • Proficiency in Big Data technologies such as Spark, PySpark, and Databricks.
  • Strong foundation in data query/manipulation using SQL and data visualization tools like Power BI.
  • Experience in Snowflake and multidimensional modeling .

Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.

  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

name: Analyst, Product Operations
description_html:
Job Description

Job ID: MJ000369

About Traveloka

Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region.

We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that.

About The Team

Accommodation owns the hotel and property booking experience across Traveloka's eleven markets — from budget guesthouses to premium international chains. We connect millions of Southeast Asian travellers to a global supplier network, and you help build the pipes that make that possible: the integrations that pull live rates, availability, and rich property content into the product, accurately and at scale.

This is connectivity work where the details decide the outcome. You will shape how we onboard supply, where rates and inventory come from, and how reliably they flow — so a traveller always sees the right property at the right price. If you like turning messy, high-volume supplier data into a fast, trustworthy booking experience for an entire region, you will have real ownership here.

About The Job

As a Product Operations Analyst on Traveloka's Accommodation team, you keep the operational engine running and turn its data into something the team can act on — executing the daily processes accurately and surfacing what the numbers are telling you.

  • Execute daily service-delivery processes, maintaining accuracy and SLAs as volumes grow
  • Follow and help refine standard operating procedures, keeping the documentation acurrate and updated
  • Troubleshoot routine operational cases, escalating the exceptions that need a judgment call
  • Pull and clean operational data into clear reporting
  • That reporting is what the team uses to spot issues and trends
  • You are fluent enough in SQL or a BI tool to answer your own questions without waiting on someone else
  • Use AI tools to draft SOPs and speed up case triage, routing exceptions to a human rather than auto-resolving them

Job Requirements

  • You have at least 2 years of relevant experience.
  • You are organized and precise.
  • You stay accurate under repetitive, high-volume work.
  • You are comfortable in spreadsheets.
  • You are starting to work with SQL or BI tooling to answer your own questions.
  • You understand the basics of how the Accommodation business works.
  • You are curious about how the numbers connect to it.
  • You communicate clearly.
  • You hold a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent depth from operational and analytical work, with around a year of experience.
  • You can flag a problem with the relevant data attached.
  • You take direction well.
  • You follow through on commitments without being chased.
  • You are comfortable using AI tools to draft documentation and speed up routine work.

Join Us

If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you.

We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days.

We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.

name: Senior Commercial Planning & Strategy
description_html:
Job Summary

This role will analyze commercial performance, evaluate campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and provide recommendations to drive growth, customer engagement, and profitability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Commercial performance analysis: monitor key metrics such as GMV, MTU, AOV, GM%, GP%, and other commercial KPIs; identify trends, gaps, opportunities, and risks.
  • Campaign & promo monitoring: monitor campaign and promotion performance, including uptake, GMV contribution, basket composition, user segments, and margin impact; highlight issues and opportunities early.
  • Cross-initiative impact analysis: assess the expected and actual impact of business initiatives on sales, customers, profitability, and other relevant metrics.
  • Promotion scheme design: support the development of promotional mechanics by modeling their potential impact on GMV, MTU, GM%, and GP%; help define target customers, basket profiles, and promo economics.
  • Post-campaign analysis: evaluate campaign effectiveness, identify whether growth was truly incremental or temporary, and assess customer retention, behavioral changes, and margin impact.
  • Competitive & market monitoring: monitor competitor activities and market developments; turn findings into clear insights and recommendations for the business.
  • Ad-hoc commercial analysis: support various strategic and operational business questions through timely, data-driven analysis and deep dives.


Requirements

  • Flexible and agile mindset: comfortable working beyond a fixed job scope and adapting to changing priorities as the business grows; willing to take on new challenges and contribute wherever analytical support is needed.
  • 5+ years of experience in commercial analytics, business analytics, or another data-heavy role within e-commerce, retail, or consumer internet.
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets and/or strong SQL skills, with the ability to build models, run scenario analysis, and turn data into structured insights.
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics such as GMV, MTU, AOV, GM%, GP%, funnel, cohort, and RFM, with the ability to understand what these metrics mean for business performance.
  • Ability to design and evaluate promotional schemes, with an understanding of promo mechanics, margin impact, customer targeting, basket behavior, and incremental growth.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analysis clearly and turn findings into practical business recommendations.
  • Proficiency in using AI tools to support analysis, automate repetitive tasks, improve productivity, and solve problems more efficiently.
  • Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent will be huge advantage

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Currently pursuing or a recent graduate of a DKV (Desain Komunikasi Visual), Product Design (S.Ds), Interactive Design, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field.
  • A strong product mindset with a passion for understanding app mechanics, user empathy, and why digital products succeed or fail.
  • Deep knowledge of visual hierarchy, layout structuring, typography, and UI/UX principles.
  • Familiarity with design and collaboration tools like Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar platforms.
  • Basic familiarity or an eager willingness to learn data tools (Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or BI tools like Tableau/Data Studio).
  • An analytical mindset—you naturally enjoy asking questions about user choices and behavioral flows.

name: Senior User Experience Research Specialist, ID
description_html:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


Introduction

We are looking for an experienced Senior User Experience Research Specialist, ID to join our global quality assurance team. You will be responsible for evaluating the product user experience of Trip in the ID market, identifying gaps between Trip and its competitors, and collaborating cross-functionally to address user pain points in the ID market.


In this Role, you’ll get to

  • Conduct user research to gain insights into user behavior and pain points specific to the ID market with the goal of providing actionable recommendations for product refinement and market growth.
  • Monitor product user experience (quality) metrics and provide valuable local insights to HQ teams.
  • Regularly conduct product user experience testing, in-depth competitor analysis, and local user research to identify any product quality defects and gaps compared to competitors.

What you'll Need to Succeed

Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com



Have a good trip, and see you soon!

name: Product Specialist (Consumer Electronics)
description_html:
Client Overview

The candidate required to work at Jakarta, Indonesia.

Our client is a leading Indonesian consumer electronics company established in 1999 and headquartered in Jakarta. The company offers a diverse range of products, including smartphones, laptops, tablets, PCs, IoT devices, wearables, and electronic accessories.

With a strong understanding of local consumer needs and a commitment to delivering innovative technology at accessible price points, the company combines agile manufacturing capabilities with a broad distribution network. It fosters a dynamic, fast-paced working environment focused on product innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.

Job Role

The Product Specialist will be responsible for strengthening the company's electronic accessories portfolio through market research, competitive analysis, technical product expertise, and product performance monitoring. The role focuses on smartwatches and smartbands, audio and TWS devices, and mobile power accessories such as power banks and chargers, ensuring products remain competitive in terms of specifications, features, pricing, quality, and market positioning.

The position will also support product certification, technical sales activities, product launches, and training for internal sales teams, promoters, and distribution partners. The successful candidate will collaborate with R&D, Legal, Operations, vendors, certification bodies, and commercial teams to ensure product readiness, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify market trends, consumer preferences, pricing strategies, and opportunities for product positioning and development.
  • Provide technical product support by preparing proposals and presentations, sharing product expertise, and assisting sales teams during customer meetings, tenders, and product demonstrations.
  • Coordinate product certification processes, including TKDN and Postel, and manage related documentation and communication with vendors, internal teams, and certification bodies.
  • Conduct product training for sales teams, promoters, and distributors, and prepare product fact sheets, sales kits, and product launch materials.
  • Monitor product quality and performance, investigate product failures, conduct root cause analysis, and recommend improvements.
  • Analyze sales data, customer complaints, and market feedback to identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Prepare monthly or quarterly reports covering sales performance, market trends, competitor activities, and strategic recommendations.


Candidate Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (S1) in Management, Marketing, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in Product Development or Product Management within the consumer electronics industry, particularly handling TWS devices, smartwatches, power banks, chargers, cables, or IT accessories.
  • Demonstrated experience in product research, competitive analysis, product positioning, product development, and go-to-market activities.
  • Practical experience in technical product presentations, product training, sales enablement, or product performance analysis.
  • Strong understanding of market research, competitive intelligence, cost analysis, profit margins, product development lifecycles, and go-to-market strategies.
  • In-depth knowledge of hardware specifications, product features, compatibility, quality management, failure analysis, and root cause identification.
  • Ability to analyze sales data, customer complaints, consumer behavior, and product performance to prepare actionable reports and recommendations.
  • Understanding of regulatory compliance and product certification requirements, including TKDN, SNI, Postel, and ISO, with the ability to support related documentation and certification processes.
  • Strong presentation, training, communication, negotiation, analytical thinking, creativity, innovation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, customers, vendors, and certification stakeholders.
  • Professional English proficiency in speaking and writing for daily stakeholder communication and reporting.

name: Data Analyst
description_html:
As a Data Analyst in the Business Analytics team, you'll be the dedicated analyst for our B2B commercial direction. You'll work as an independent contributor, side by side with the commercial team. You'll find growth opportunities in the data, form and test hypotheses, and measure the impact of business initiatives that are not product features. Your first projects will be supporting and developing our pricing override and cost modifier processes, designing experiments around the credit limits we give B2B partners to help grow their booking volumes, and evaluating the financial and customer impact of opening local legal entities in new markets. A/B testing alone often isn't enough here, so you'll choose and apply other methods, such as difference-in-differences or causal impact. There is no ready-made playbook. You'll set your own approach, and project managers on both sides will help you run the work. The role suits a self-driven analyst who wants real ownership and visible impact on commercial decisions, and it can grow as the direction expands.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in business, data or product analytics
  • Strong SQL, including writing efficient, fast-running queries
  • Confident Python and its data libraries: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit-learn and others
  • Hands-on experience with difference-in-differences
  • Experience with causal inference methods: Causal Impact, Propensity Score Matching and similar
  • Solid knowledge of statistics and experience designing and running A/B tests and other experiments
  • Ability to dive deep into business processes, solve non-standard problems and work independently
  • Fluent Russian and English B2

Nice to have

  • Experience with time series forecasting (Prophet, ARIMA, Exponential Smoothing or similar)
  • Experience in B2B, commercial or partner analytics
  • Experience onboarding or mentoring junior colleagues
  • Hands-on use of AI tools, such as Copilot or agents, to speed up your work

Benefits

  • Flexible schedules and opportunity to work remotely
  • Ambitious and supportive team who love what they do, appreciate each other, and grow together
  • A structured onboarding, a personal development plan, and regular internal lectures and demos from the team
  • Internal programs for adaptation and training, development of soft skills, and leadership abilities
  • Partial compensation for participating in external training and conferences
  • Corporate English school: Group and individual lessons, speaking clubs with colleagues from all over the world
  • Corporate prices on hotels and travel services
  • MyTime Day Off - an extra non-working day without loss of compensation

description_html:
ATM Cash Forecasting & Planning

  • Melakukan analisis kebutuhan cash pada jaringan ATM berdasarkan histori transaksi, pola penggunaan, lokasi, dan tren kebutuhan nasabah.
  • Menyusun forecast kebutuhan uang tunai untuk setiap mesin ATM secara harian, mingguan, dan bulanan.

  • Mendukung optimalisasi rute dan jadwal pengisian ATM bersama tim terkait.

Reporting & Improvement

description_html:
Role Description

As a Sales Administration & Analyst Specialist, you will support the commercial team by keeping sales administration accurate, organized, and data-driven. You will help manage customer information, monitor orders, prepare sales documents, and turn sales data into clear insights for the team. Working with sales, supply chain, production planning, production, and warehouse colleagues, you will improve order visibility, reporting accuracy, and workflow efficiency while contributing to reliable customer service and business growth.

Your Mission

  • Support Sales Operations – Provide accurate daily administrative support so the sales team can focus on customer acquisition and relationship management.
  • Manage Sales Documents – Prepare, verify, and distribute quotations, contracts, and sales orders with a high level of accuracy.
  • Maintain Customer Data – Update CRM and ERP records to keep contact details, transaction history, and quotation statuses current.
  • Analyze Sales Performance – Compile, clean, and evaluate sales data to identify purchasing trends, order volumes, pricing insights, and workflow bottlenecks.
  • Deliver Reporting Insights – Create regular sales reports and dashboards that support clear, data-driven decisions for the sales team and management.
  • Coordinate Order Fulfillment – Work with supply chain, production planning, production, and warehouse teams to monitor order progress, delivery timelines, and product availability.
  • Improve Forecasting Efficiency – Support demand forecasting and quotation-to-order analysis to help reduce material shortages, overstock risks, and process inefficiencies.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, management, industrial engineering, mathematics, statistics, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sales administration, sales operations, or data analysis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, advanced formulas, macros, and Power Query.
  • Experience using ERP or CRM systems and supporting order fulfillment workflows.
  • Business-level communication skills in English (C-1).

About Us

Hertz Flavors is an internationally oriented, globally leading, medium-sized company in the chemical industry, specialized in the development and production of flavors. For over 65 years, we have been developing customized product solutions in collaboration with our customers from our location near Hamburg. As an expanding and agile company with a highly motivated team, we are continuously growing and looking for new team members.

You define what you work on, how you deliver it, and what comes next.

  • Entrepreneurial way of working — End-to-end ownership from proposal to delivery. You can design new service lines, launch in new countries, and build what doesn't exist yet. This is a culture where you create your own opportunities.

The Master Data Business Analyst will define data, master data and reporting requirements from the business users and pro-actively challenge those data and reporting requirements along with defining the required Data Governance to implement.

The Master Data Business Analyst will generate insights and report in an easy-to-understand format and proffer recommendations to solve business problems and improve the utilization of data across the organization.

The Master Data Business Analyst will review and map business processes to understand our client’s ways of working and define the Master Data requirements to support each business process to support the Master Data definition for the implementation of our client’s digital solutions (ERP, FICO, HCM, etc).

The Master Data Business Analyst will interpret data, patterns, and trends, analyse results, and use statistical techniques along with third-party solutions and provide with potential solutions. The Master Data Business Analyst will be able to create the required visualizations and dashboards in Microsoft PowerBI, Tableau or Qlik Sense.

Department: Credit Risk & Data Science

Location: Global

About FINN

FINN is a fintech company building simple and transparent products that improve financial well-being for underbanked employees. Our core offering gives people access to wages they have already earned, alongside tools that help them manage money better, build savings, access insurance, earn additional income, and use fairer financial services.

Founded in 2022, FINN is the largest player in the early wage access space in Southeast Asia and is expanding rapidly into new markets globally. We are looking for ambitious builders who take ownership, move fast, and want to shape products that create meaningful impact in people's lives.

About The Role

We are looking for a Head of Credit Risk to own and lead FINN's credit risk strategy, underwriting policies, and portfolio performance as we expand across Southeast Asia and other markets.

This is a senior risk leadership role focused on balancing sustainable growth, responsible lending, and portfolio profitability. You will own the end-to-end credit risk lifecycle, from risk appetite and underwriting strategy to portfolio monitoring, credit policy optimization, and loss management.

You will leverage data science and machine learning to strengthen credit decisioning, improve risk segmentation, and expand access to financial services for underserved customers. You will lead a team of risk analysts and data scientists, ensuring that models and analytical tools translate into effective credit policies and measurable business outcomes.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and executive leadership, you will establish a scalable, data-driven credit risk function that supports FINN's growth while maintaining strong portfolio quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Credit Risk Strategy & Portfolio Management
  • Own FINN's credit risk strategy, risk appetite, underwriting policies, and approval frameworks across products and markets.
  • Develop and continuously optimize credit policies, risk thresholds, and customer segmentation strategies to balance approval rates, credit losses, and risk-adjusted returns.
  • Own portfolio performance monitoring, including delinquency, roll rates, default rates, loss rates, and other key credit risk indicators.
  • Establish early warning systems to identify emerging portfolio risks and implement timely corrective actions.
  • Lead portfolio reviews, risk assessments, scenario analysis, and stress testing to evaluate portfolio resilience under different economic and business conditions.
  • Partner with Finance on expected credit loss modeling, provisioning, and portfolio-level financial risk assessments.
  • Ensure credit risk policies are appropriate for each market and aligned with applicable regulatory requirements and responsible lending standards.
  • Develop and maintain clear risk governance frameworks, escalation processes, and reporting for executive leadership.
  • Underwriting & Credit Decisioning
  • Own the end-to-end underwriting strategy, including customer eligibility, credit assessment, approval rules, and risk-based decisioning.
  • Improve approval rates and customer conversion while maintaining target default rates and portfolio quality.
  • Develop and refine risk segmentation strategies to identify underserved customer segments with attractive risk-adjusted returns.
  • Use portfolio performance data and customer behavior to continuously improve underwriting policies and credit decisions.
  • Design and evaluate controlled experiments, policy tests, and champion-challenger strategies to measure the impact of underwriting changes.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to implement scalable, automated credit decisioning processes that reduce time-to-decision and friction in the customer journey.
  • Evaluate alternative data sources, credit bureaus, and external partnerships to strengthen risk assessment and improve coverage of underserved populations.
  • Data Science & ML-Driven Risk Management
  • Lead the application of data science and machine learning to credit scoring, underwriting, risk segmentation, and fraud detection.
  • Define model requirements and work with data scientists and engineers to develop, validate, deploy, and continuously improve credit risk models.
  • Ensure models translate into effective underwriting policies and measurable improvements in approval rates, losses, and risk-adjusted portfolio performance.
  • Establish appropriate model monitoring, validation, interpretability, fairness, and drift detection practices.
  • Oversee model experimentation, performance evaluation, and ongoing optimization across products and markets.
  • Ensure credit decisioning systems are scalable, reliable, and suitable for real-time or near-real-time decisions.
  • Provide technical direction to the data science team while maintaining sufficient hands-on understanding to challenge assumptions, assess model quality, and guide technical decisions.
  • Team & Strategic Leadership
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of credit risk professionals, analysts, and data scientists.
  • Establish clear ownership, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans across the risk and data science functions.
  • Own the credit risk roadmap and align priorities with business objectives, product development, and market expansion.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Operations to embed risk considerations into business decisions and customer experiences.
  • Present portfolio performance, emerging risks, risk strategy, and recommendations to executive leadership and the board.
  • Build a culture of accountability, experimentation, responsible risk-taking, and evidence-based decision-making.

Business Impact & Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured primarily by the strength and sustainability of FINN's credit portfolio and the effectiveness of its underwriting strategy.

Key Outcomes Include

  • Portfolio quality: Maintain delinquency, default, and credit loss rates within agreed risk appetite.
  • Risk-adjusted growth: Increase approvals and customer access while preserving sustainable portfolio returns.
  • Underwriting effectiveness: Improve credit decision accuracy, risk segmentation, and policy performance.
  • Operational efficiency: Reduce time-to-decision and manual intervention through effective automated underwriting.
  • Early risk detection: Identify portfolio deterioration promptly and implement effective mitigation strategies.
  • Model effectiveness: Demonstrate measurable improvements in credit outcomes through ML-driven decisioning and model optimization.
  • Scalable risk management: Establish consistent risk frameworks that can adapt to new products, markets, and regulatory environments.
  • Team effectiveness: Build a strong credit risk and data science function with clear accountability and technical capability.

Your Profile

Required

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience across credit risk, consumer lending, credit analytics, or data science, with substantial experience leading credit risk strategy and managing consumer credit portfolios.
  • Proven ownership of credit policies, underwriting frameworks, risk appetite, and portfolio performance within fintech, digital lending, consumer finance, BNPL, digital banking, or a related financial services business.
  • Demonstrated success balancing approval growth, credit losses, portfolio quality, and risk-adjusted returns.
  • Experience managing credit risk across multiple products, customer segments, or markets.
  • Strong understanding of credit risk metrics, portfolio monitoring, delinquency trends, default behavior, loss forecasting, and risk mitigation.
  • Experience applying credit scoring, statistical modeling, or machine learning to underwriting and credit decisioning.
  • Sufficient technical depth to evaluate ML-based credit models, challenge model assumptions, and guide data scientists in model development and deployment.
  • Experience leading and developing teams of credit risk professionals, analysts, and/or data scientists.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including the ability to interpret model outputs and translate insights into actionable credit policies.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect credit decisions to customer acquisition, portfolio profitability, and business growth.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain risk trade-offs clearly.
  • A proactive, adaptable approach suited to a fast-growing, international startup environment.

Bonus

  • Experience in Southeast Asian credit markets, including familiarity with local credit bureaus, alternative data sources, and lending practices.
  • Experience in earned wage access, consumer fintech, or lending products serving underbanked customers.
  • Familiarity with ML model deployment, MLOps, model monitoring frameworks, and experimentation platforms.
  • Understanding of IFRS 9, expected credit loss modeling, and applicable credit regulations across multiple markets.
  • Experience launching credit products or establishing risk frameworks in new markets.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and location.
  • Equity participation.
  • The opportunity to build and shape FINN's credit risk function as the business scales.
  • The opportunity to influence credit strategy, underwriting, and portfolio performance across multiple markets.
  • The opportunity to work with modern data science and machine learning capabilities.
  • A mission-driven environment focused on improving financial well-being and expanding responsible access to financial services.

Why Join FINN?

  • Meaningful Impact: Help expand responsible financial access for underbanked employees.
  • Strategic Ownership: Shape credit risk strategy and portfolio performance at a growing fintech.
  • Greenfield Opportunity: Build scalable underwriting and risk management capabilities from the ground up.
  • Technology-Enabled Risk Management: Apply data science and machine learning to improve credit decisions and business outcomes.
  • Global Growth: Help establish sustainable credit risk frameworks as FINN enters new markets.
  • Mission-Driven Work: Contribute to fairer, more transparent financial services.

name: Data Cruncher and Inventory Demand Forecaster (Holding Company)
description_html:
This role requires the candidate to work in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.

Client Overview

Our client is a diversified holding group with business interests spanning mining services, heavy engineering, infrastructure development, and large-scale agricultural technology operations. Through its portfolio of operating companies, the organization manages complex supply chains, large-scale asset deployments, and geographically dispersed operations that require sophisticated planning, inventory management, and operational coordination to support business continuity and sustainable growth.

Operating across multiple industries and regions, the group relies heavily on data-driven decision-making to optimize resource allocation, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen supply chain performance. The organization offers a dynamic environment where analytical professionals can work directly with executive leadership, contribute to strategic operational initiatives, and influence critical business decisions through advanced forecasting, inventory optimization, and operational analytics.

Job Role

The Data Cruncher & Inventory Demand Forecaster is responsible for developing predictive inventory models, demand forecasting frameworks, and operational analytics that support the group's diverse business operations. The role focuses on transforming large volumes of operational, inventory, and supply chain data into actionable insights that improve inventory availability, reduce excess stock, optimize working capital utilization, and support business planning across multiple subsidiaries.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with operations, procurement, warehouse, logistics, engineering, and management teams to identify trends, forecast material requirements, and strengthen supply chain performance. This position is ideal for analytical professionals who possess strong quantitative capabilities and enjoy applying data science, forecasting methodologies, and operational analytics to solve complex business challenges within asset-intensive industries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, validate, organize, and analyze large operational datasets from multiple business units, warehouses, and project sites.
  • Develop and maintain demand forecasting models for critical inventory categories, including spare parts, consumables, operational materials, fuel allocations, and other strategic inventory items.
  • Monitor inventory performance, consumption trends, supplier lead times, stock movements, and warehouse utilization metrics to improve planning accuracy.
  • Calculate safety stock levels, reorder points, Economic Order Quantity (EOQ), and inventory optimization parameters to support business continuity and cost efficiency.
  • Design dashboards, analytical reports, and performance tracking tools that provide visibility into inventory health, operational efficiency, and supply chain risks.
  • Identify inventory inefficiencies, excess stock, obsolete materials, duplicate purchases, and working capital optimization opportunities through data analysis.
  • Support procurement teams with forecasting insights, purchasing recommendations, and inventory planning strategies.
  • Collaborate with warehouse, logistics, operations, engineering, and supply chain stakeholders to align inventory requirements with operational activities and project schedules.
  • Support Material Requirements Planning (MRP) processes and ensure alignment between forecasted demand and procurement activities.
  • Review and improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and information integrity within ERP systems and operational databases.
  • Present analytical findings, inventory forecasts, and operational recommendations to management teams and executive stakeholders.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Business Analytics, or other quantitative disciplines.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Demand Planning, Inventory Planning, Supply Chain Analytics, Operations Analytics, Data Analysis, or related analytical functions.
  • Proven experience within mining contractors, heavy equipment industries, automotive supply chains, industrial distribution, manufacturing, agriculture, logistics, or other asset-intensive sectors.
  • Strong understanding of inventory management principles, forecasting methodologies, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), supply chain optimization, and operational analytics.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, scenario analysis, and large dataset management.
  • Experience utilizing ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar enterprise platforms.
  • Practical experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, R, or other business intelligence and analytical tools is highly preferred.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, attention to detail, and ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills with the ability to interact effectively with both operational and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Highly adaptable, resilient, and capable of operating effectively within fast-paced, multi-industry business environments.
  • Willingness to travel regularly to operational sites, warehouses, and project locations as required.
  • Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required for reporting, analysis, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.

name: IoT Data Lead
description_html:
McEasy, a transportation management solution to simplify complex logistics operations. is looking for a IoT Data Lead to join our ever-growing team.


If you are a keen learner, self-driven, and looking to be a part of a team that is passionate with helping each other, we want to hear from you.


What will you do?

As IoT Data Lead, you will own the correctness of device data end to end, from the moment it enters McEasy’s platform to the moment a customer sees it. You will work across the IoT, data platform and SaaS teams without managing them directly, and hold the decision authority on how device data is defined, processed and changed.

  • Be the final decision-maker on how device data is defined, interpreted and stored (units, sources, fields, logic)
  • Own the data contract and keep it complete, consistent and agreed by the IoT, data platform and SaaS teams
  • Resolve conflicts between technical documents and product requirements
  • Answer open cross-team questions within an agreed timeframe, and bring clear recommendations when leadership input is needed
  • Keep a decision log with each decision, its reason and who it affects
  • Review and approve processing logic changes, schema changes and new device integrations before release
  • Check downstream dependencies (features, reports, fields) before approving any data change
  • Maintain a single register of processing rules and settings, including what each does, who sets it and who depends on it
  • Create and maintain a standard onboarding checklist for new devices (fields, timezones, units, buffering, test cases)
  • Make sure new devices are verified on our own platform, and feed post-release issues back into the checklist
  • Take ownership of escalated issues where the root cause is unclear or moves between teams
  • Make sure customer issues are closed on fixes that actually shipped
  • Work closely with engineers, Product Owners and QA, and explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical teams


Qualification:

  • Experienced in IoT, telematics, data engineering or backend engineering
  • Hands-on understanding of the full device data path: device protocols (e.g. GPS, OBD/CAN), data ingestion, data processing, and how applications consume the data
  • Proven track record of making technical decisions that other teams adopt, without formal authority over them
  • Ability to write clear requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build and test against
  • Comfortable saying “no” or “not yet” to changes that aren’t ready, and explaining why
  • Ability to structure ambiguous cross-team problems and decide who needs to be involved, and in what order
  • Strong written communication in English [and Bahasa Indonesia]
  • Experience with data contracts, schema governance or multi-vendor device integration is a plus
  • Background in mechatronics, electronics or electrical engineering is a plus



Additional Notes:

  • This is not a people management role. The IoT, data platform and SaaS teams keep their own leads, hiring and performance reviews.
  • You decide and verify, while the teams build. This role is not expected to build all processing logic yourself.
  • You define acceptance criteria and sign off on changes, but independent testing stays with the QA team.
  • This role does not cover UI, firmware development or hardware design.
  • You are expected to scale your decisions through clear rules and checklists, so routine approvals don’t depend on you.



Ready to make a difference? Join our team and be part of something extraordinary. Apply now!

• KPI Administration & Cascading Support
    • Menyiapkan data, format, dan dokumen pendukung penyusunan KPI korporasi dan unit kerja berdasarkan sasaran strategis serta rencana kerja perusahaan.
    • Mendukung proses cascading KPI dengan memastikan keterkaitan indikator, target, formula, sumber data, periode evaluasi, dan penanggung jawab.
  • Performance Data Collection & Validation
    • Mengumpulkan data realisasi KPI dari unit kerja sesuai periode monitoring yang ditetapkan.
    • Memeriksa kelengkapan, konsistensi, dan kesesuaian data terhadap formula serta sumber data KPI.
    • Melakukan klarifikasi kepada unit terkait apabila terdapat ketidaksesuaian, kekurangan, atau anomali data kinerja
  • Performance Monitoring & Analysis
    • Memantau realisasi KPI korporasi dan unit kerja secara berkala terhadap target yang telah ditetapkan.
    • Mengolah dan menganalisis data untuk mengidentifikasi gap, tren pencapaian, serta potensi risiko ketidaktercapaian target.
    • Menyiapkan analisis awal atas penyebab deviasi sebagai bahan evaluasi Kepala Departemen.
  • Performance Reporting & Dashboard
    • Menyusun laporan kinerja periodik yang memuat realisasi, target, status pencapaian, dan isu utama kinerja.
    • Menyiapkan dan memperbarui dashboard kinerja yang mengintegrasikan indikator finansial dan nonfinansial.
    • Menyiapkan bahan paparan dan data pendukung untuk management review, Direksi, maupun kebutuhan pelaporan lainnya.
  • Corrective Action Monitoring
    • Mengadministrasikan rencana tindakan korektif atas KPI atau program kerja yang mengalami deviasi.
    • Memantau progres dan status tindak lanjut perbaikan dari unit kerja terkait.
    • Mengidentifikasi corrective action yang belum efektif atau mengalami keterlambatan untuk dilaporkan kepada Kepala Departemen.
  • Performance Governance & Documentation
    • Melaksanakan proses pengelolaan kinerja sesuai kebijakan, prosedur, kalender, dan mekanisme yang ditetapkan.
    • Memastikan bukti pendukung, histori perubahan, dan dokumentasi data kinerja tersimpan secara lengkap serta dapat ditelusuri.
    • Mendukung pemanfaatan sistem digital dan tools performance management untuk meningkatkan akurasi serta efisiensi monitoring.
    • Pengelolaan data dan pelaporan a. Mengumpulkan, memeriksa, mengolah, dan memelihara data serta dokumen pekerjaan
Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimal S1 di bidang Manajemen, Teknik Industri, Ekonomi, Statistika, Administrasi Bisnis, Akuntansi, atau bidang lain yang relevan.
  • Pengalaman dibidang yang sama Min. 2-3 tahun
  • Memiliki keahlian mendalam dalam manajemen kinerja dan eksekusi strategi, mencakup KPI & Performance Measurement, Corporate Performance Review, serta Strategic Initiative & Portfolio Management. Keahlian ini didukung oleh kapabilitas dalam Data Analytics, Business Analysis, Business Reporting, serta tata kelola Sertifikasi Tertentu untuk memastikan pencapaian target organisasi

name: Corporate Banking Business Strategy Specialist
description_html:
Responsible for delivering in-depth analytical insights and supporting high-quality service to drive effective business strategy, operational excellence, and risk mitigation within Corporate Banking. The role focuses on data-driven analysis, performance monitoring, and supporting strategic initiatives without direct people management responsibilities.


Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Planning

  • Support the development and implementation of business strategies aligned with the Bank’s targets, operational plans, and budgeting process.
  • Conduct continuous review of policies and procedures to support effective implementation and enhance productivity and service quality.
  • Identify opportunities for value creation through data analysis (internal & external) and market/competitor scanning.
  • Support the development of frameworks and tools to measure RM productivity and individual performance to drive achievement of financial targets and manpower planning.
  • Assist in developing pipeline management frameworks and tools to monitor loan drawdown realization and pipeline progress.
  • Support the execution of reward/recognition programs and internal communication strategies for business initiatives and campaigns.


Business Performance & Management

  • Monitor and analyze loan pipeline (realization, cancellation, delay) to identify insights and improvement areas.
  • Provide projection analysis based on pipeline performance to support management in tracking gaps vs targets.
  • Deliver market intelligence and competitor insights to support strategic and tactical decision-making.
  • Support budget monitoring and utilization tracking for the business unit.
  • Prepare monthly performance reports with strong financial analysis, insights, and actionable recommendations.
  • Maintain and manage comprehensive financial and performance databases to support portfolio monitoring and strategic initiatives.
  • Support risk management monitoring, particularly operational risk awareness and adherence to policies/procedures.
  • Monitor fulfillment of covenants, documentation requirements, and ensure proper credit file management in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure strong coordination with internal stakeholders (including Legal, Credit, Operations) to support smooth transaction processing and client servicing.
  • Contribute to maintaining service quality and strong relationships with internal and external clients.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree from a reputable university (Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field).
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Corporate Banking, Business Strategy, MIS, or Performance Management.
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret financial data and translate into actionable insights.
  • Experience in preparing management reports, financial analysis, and business performance monitoring.
  • Good understanding of corporate banking products (loan, trade, cash, etc.) and processes.
  • Familiarity with budgeting, forecasting, and pipeline management concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel/PowerPoint; experience with data tools/dashboarding is a plus.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.

name: Business Controller
description_html:
ECCO Tannery Indonesia Overview

ECCO Tannery Indonesia is part of ECCO Leather, a global leather manufacturing platform under ECCO Sko A/S, a Danish family-owned company. The business operates state-of-the-art tannery facilities across Asia, combining craftsmanship, innovation, and a strong commitment to sustainability and operational excellence.

Role Overview

We are currently seeking an accomplished Business Controller to join our team in Sidoarjo business unit.

This role is responsible to work closely with various core of business operation to providing critical business performance insight for our management. The key function of this role must be familiar with data analysis to providing cost data, business trends, and analysis financially.

The great fit candidate for this position is strong analytical, problem solving skill, detail-oriented, comfortable working with large amounts of data with knowledge of Lean Management or Six Sigma would be an advantage.

Your role will be including, but not limited to :

  • Provide costing and business performance analysis and reporting
  • Monitor business performance trends, risk and opportunities
  • Reconcile raw material consumption, inventory and production waste
  • Support regular internal audit, including stock counts and verifications
  • Work closely with stakeholder to provide relevant business insight

The Ideal Candidate

  • Bring over 3 years experience in Business Controlling / Process Engineer / Data Engineer or any similar role and supported by relevant educational background in Industrial Engineering / Chemical Engineering or any related discipline
  • Proven experiences in data management and data analysis with proficiency tools such as Power BI and SQL in manufacturing with fast paced and dynamic environment
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge in business acumen with ability to translate data into business insight
  • Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and proficiency in Business English

Let’s embark your career milestone with us, a multinational and dynamic working environment.

name: Marketing Analyst
description_html:
Trước khi bạn nộp đơn xin việc, hãy chọn tùy chọn ngôn ngữ của bạn từ các tùy chọn có sẵn ở trên cùng bên phải của trang này.

Khám phá cơ hội tiếp theo của bạn tại tổ chức Fortune Global 500. Hình dung các khả năng đổi mới, trải nghiệm văn hóa bổ ích của chúng tôi và làm việc với các nhóm đầy tài năng giúp bạn trở nên tốt hơn mỗi ngày. Chúng tôi hiểu những gì cần thiết để dẫn dắt UPS trong tương lai — những người có khả năng kết hợp độc đáo giữa năng lực với niềm đam mê. Nếu bạn có tố chất và khả năng lãnh đạo bản thân hoặc nhóm, sẽ có những vai trò sẵn sàng để bạn trau dồi kỹ năng và đưa bạn lên một tầm cao mới.

Mô Tả Công Việc

This position performs advanced administrative responsibilities, including preparation and analysis of more complex reports, compilation of information from various sources and handling small scale projects and analysis using various software packages. The incumbent may direct the work of others and provide instruction and guidance to less experienced employees. This position performs general office duties that may include word processing, data entry, auditing documents, answering phones, distributing mail, reserving conference rooms, coordinating meetings and other duties as assigned. This role may deal with confidential material on a regular basis.

Job Summary

The Marketing Data Analyst is responsible for analyzing marketing, customer, and commercial data for the Indonesia market. This role develops dashboards, identifies business trends, and translates complex data into actionable insights to support management decision-making and business performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, validate, and consolidate data from multiple sources.
  • Analyze revenue, shipment volume, customer acquisition, retention, churn, and profitability.
  • Develop customer segmentation and identify high-value, high-potential, and at-risk customers.
  • Build and maintain automated dashboards and recurring performance reports.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly performance reports in presentation format for management and key stakeholders.
  • Measure marketing campaign performance, including conversion, revenue contribution, and return on investment.
  • Conduct trend, variance, root-cause, forecasting, and scenario analysis in timely.
  • Integrate internal business data with market, industry, and competitor information.
  • Present analytical findings and recommendations to regional and country stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Finance, Technology, and other cross-functional teams include partners.
  • Maintain data accuracy, reporting consistency, and appropriate data confidentiality.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • Experience in logistics, transportation, e-commerce, or B2B services is an advantage.
  • Minimum 2–4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, customer analytics, or marketing analytics.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Power BI.
  • Strong analytical, data visualization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Key Competencies

  • Data analysis and visualization
  • Business and customer analytics
  • Dashboard development
  • Forecasting and statistical analysis
  • Data accuracy and attention to detail
  • Business insight communication
  • Cross-functional collaboration

name: Commercial Operations Executive
description_html:
We Are The People Who Give Possibilities Purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.

Job Description

  • Sales Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP)
  • Support monthly forecasting and demand planning activities
  • Consolidate and analyze sales, inventory, and demand data
  • Monitor inventory levels, stock availability, and backorder situations
  • Assist in identifying inventory risks and supply gaps
  • Prepare reports and presentations for monthly SIOP reviews
  • Support product launch and inventory readiness planning activities

  • Maintain distributor performance trackers and dashboards
  • Monitor distributor inventory levels and stock aging

  • Assist in resolving operational issues related to order fulfillment and inventory management

  • Maintain monthly E&O tracking reports and supporting documentation
  • Assist in preparing expiry and obsolete inventory accrual calculations
  • Work with sales and supply chain teams to identify mitigation opportunities
  • Track execution of inventory reduction and stock rotation actions
  • Support periodic inventory reviews and reconciliation activities
  • Commercial Operations & Business Analytics
  • Prepare routine commercial reports and performance dashboards
  • Analyze sales trends, inventory movement, and business performance metrics
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews
  • Ensure data accuracy across reports and analytical tool.
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on business data analysis
  • Support forecasting and budgeting activities through data preparation
  • Process Improvement & Governance
  • Assist in identifying opportunities to improve operational processes and reporting efficiency
  • Support implementation of standardized procedures and best practices
  • Maintain process documentation and reporting guidelines
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls and business governance requirements
  • Support audit preparation and data validation activities
  • SEA Data Automation Support
  • Support development and maintenance of Power BI dashboards and automated reports
  • Assist in automating recurring data consolidation and reporting tasks
  • Participate in regional automation and digital transformation projects
  • Collaborate with SEA stakeholders to improve report effectiveness and data visibility
  • Support data cleansing, validation, and governance initiatives
  • Help reduce manual reporting efforts through automation tools and process enhancements

Why Join Us?

To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.

We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.

name: HR System & Analytics Specialist
description_html:
General Description

HR System & Analytics Specialist will play a vital role in driving data-informed decision-making and enhancing HR operations through HRIS optimization and analytics. This role is responsible for ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of HR systems and data products, enabling the People team to improve workforce insights, operational excellence, and employee experience. The position requires strong analytical skills, HR systems knowledge, and stakeholder engagement capability.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Deliver analytical insights through dashboards, reports, and presentations to support People strategy and business decisions
  2. Manage HRIS modules (Employee Data, Attendance, etc.), ensuring data accuracy, compliance, and optimal configuration
  3. Act as a bridge between People stakeholders and BI/Data teams, translating technical outputs into business-relevant insights
  4. Identify opportunities for automation and feature enhancements to improve HR efficiency and employee experience
  5. Support design, testing, and rollout of HRIS enhancements, including writing test scenarios and conducting UAT
  6. Develop and maintain HR analytics data products for ongoing performance and workforce monitoring
  7. Create and update user documentation, conduct training sessions, and provide day-to-day support for HR system users
  8. Collaborate across all functions in People Dept (TA, Payroll, C&B, L&D, ODPMTM, etc.) to optimize workflows and ensure HR systems fully support operational excellence
  9. Ensure compliance of HR processes and system workflows with internal policies and regulatory requirements
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • Min 4 years of professional experience in HR systems, data analytics, or HR operations
  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience managing HRIS platforms
  • Proven track record of designing reports, building dashboards, and providing data insights to non-technical stakeholders
  • Proficient in SQL, Excel/Google Sheets (advanced formulas; e.g: Macros Programming).
  • Advance in data visualization tools is a plus point (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
  • Strong understanding of HR processes (employee data, attendance, payroll interface, compliance)
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking, with curiosity to uncover patterns and provide actionable insights
  • Effective project management skills with ability to prioritize multiple deliverables
  • Experience in People Operations (e.g., insurance administration and HR services) is a plus point
  • Excellent communication skills to translate technical outputs into business-relevant narratives
  • Ownership-driven, detail-oriented, and adaptable to fast-paced environments
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and proactive in proposing process/system improvements

About Company:

Founded in 1990, AI Signal Research, Inc. (ASRI) is a trusted provider of advanced technical services and support products to the aerospace and defense communities. Our services include Test Services & Range Operations, Engineering & Test Solutions, Emerging Technologies Support, Logistics Support, and Acquisition & Program Management Support. As a world leader in services and solutions for the U.S. Government, ASRI offers the ability to work on dynamic, complex tasks that advance critical missions.

When you join us, you become part of a team aiming to achieve the extraordinary, together. We believe that our people are our greatest asset. We are committed to doing what’s right for our customers and employees to ensure our shared success!

About The Role:

The Computer System Analyst II plays a critical role in bridging the gap between business needs and technology solutions within an organization. This position involves analyzing existing computer systems and procedures to identify opportunities for improvement and increased efficiency. The analyst will collaborate closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, design system modifications, and ensure that technology implementations align with organizational goals. They will also be responsible for troubleshooting system issues, optimizing performance, and supporting the deployment of new applications or upgrades. Ultimately, this role ensures that computer systems effectively support business operations and contribute to overall organizational success.

Education: See Months/Years of Experience

Months/Years of Experience: Must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related discipline from an accredited college/university and three (3) years of applicable experience; an Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related discipline and five (5) years of applicable experience; or seven (7) years of applicable experience. Applicable experience includes performing software development, analysis, integration and related functions for research, development, test and evaluation in support of military equipment and systems; analysis and design of application interfaces and integration; translation of user requests and processes into detailed functional and technical specifications; and development of interface specifications, report guidance lines and formats, policies, procedures, and system documentation.

Required Qualifications: U.S. Citizen. Must have or be able to obtain a security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications: *Professional certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or similar. *Provide end-user support on IT systems and assets including hardware, OS, printing, and networking. *Familiarity with programming or scripting languages like Python, Java, or PowerShell. *Install IT systems and assets ensuring compliance with IT Security Policy, Documentation Policy, and Service Level Agreements. *Execute duties on Information Systems (IS) within test environments and shall include determining mitigations for identified vulnerabilities, troubleshooting IT problems, assisting with planning test capability setup, maintaining RTC test and mission capability accreditations.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct detailed analysis of current computer systems and workflows to identify areas for enhancement. *Collaborate with business units to gather and document system requirements and translate them into technical specifications. *Design, test, and implement system modifications or new applications to meet business needs. *Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for existing systems to ensure optimal performance and reliability. *Coordinate with IT teams and vendors to manage system upgrades, integrations, and deployments. *Develop and maintain documentation related to system configurations, processes, and user guides. *Train end-users and provide technical assistance to ensure smooth adoption of new systems or features.
  • Monitor system performance metrics and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and security.

Skills: The required skills enable the analyst to effectively evaluate and improve computer systems by understanding both technical and business perspectives. Analytical skills are used daily to dissect complex workflows and identify system inefficiencies. Communication skills facilitate collaboration with stakeholders to gather requirements and explain technical concepts clearly. Technical proficiency in databases and system design supports the development and implementation of effective solutions. Preferred skills such as programming and cloud knowledge enhance the analyst’s ability to work with modern technologies and contribute to innovative system improvements.
